Class HealInsightsAggregator

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.doctor.history.HealInsightsAggregator
public final class HealInsightsAggregator extends Object
Aggregates persisted SHAFT Heal reports into Reporting-canvas heal insights (issue #5972 / S3-06).

FR-001: dashboard counts by HealingDecision status. FR-002: canProposeSourcePatch only when RECOVERED + passing action (persist-on-pass). FR-003: never auto-writes locators — clients must call doctor_propose_healed_locator for a reviewable diff, then a separate explicit Doctor repair publish. SC-001: AMBIGUOUS primary action is HealInsightModels.PrimaryAction.NONE. SC-002: RECOVERED + pass offers HealInsightModels.PrimaryAction.REVIEW_DIFF. Edge: NO_CANDIDATES is counted and listed; failed replay never sets canProposeSourcePatch.
